title: Galle Gallants reach LPL 2026 Final
byline: Galle Gallants stormed into the LPL 2026 final with a six-wicket victory over Colombo Kaps in Qualifier 2 at the R. Premadasa International Cricket Stadium in Colombo on Friday.

title: US expects deal soon on Strait of Hormuz; Sunni powers unite in defense pact
byline: A U.S. official on Friday reported progress between Iran and Oman that could soon reopen the Strait ​of Hormuz, potentially restoring oil exports that have been disrupted by the five-month-old U.S. war with Iran.

title: Prison system under severe strain
byline: A wave of violent unrest across Sri Lanka’s prison system since July 5 has raised serious concerns over overcrowding, security failures, and the management of high-risk inmates, prompting calls for urgent government intervention to prevent further incidents and protect both prison officers and inmates.

title: Lanka Sathosa reduces prices of 10 essential food items
byline: Lanka Sathosa has announced a reduction in the prices of 10 essential food items with effect from today.

title: Thai PM vows to introduce stricter gun laws after eight killed in shooting
byline: Thailand’s prime minister has vowed to introduce new gun control laws in the wake of a shooting by a teenager on the outskirts of Bangkok that left eight people dead and 22 injured.

title: Eight dead, including teen suspect's grandparents, in Thailand shooting
byline: First he shot dead his grandparents, using his grandfather’s handgun, then went to a secondary school in Nonthaburi province, bordering Bangkok, and killed three teachers and three students, national police said in a statement.

title: Grade 5 scholarship exam to be held at 2,723 centres tomorrow
byline: The 2026 Grade 5 Scholarship Examination will be held tomorrow (09) at 2,723 examination centres across the island, with 294,089 candidates expected to sit for the examination, the Examinations Department said.

title: Hong Kong-based Transwell submits zero-treasury turnaround proposal with strict KPIs for SriLankan Airlines
byline: Hong Kong-based private equity firm Transwell Corporation Limited has submitted a comprehensive private investor-led turnaround and restructuring proposal for loss-making SriLankan Airlines, outlining a strict milestone-based roadmap to achieve sustainable profitability within 24 to 36 months.

title: Showers exceeding 75 mm in several areas: Met. Department
byline: The Meteorology Department forecast showers exceeding 75 mm in several areas including Sabaragamuwa province and in Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts.

title: Over 749 killed in motorcycle crashes so far this year
byline: More than 749 people have died in motorcycle accidents in Sri Lanka during the first seven months of this year, prompting authorities to reiterate the importance of wearing SLS-certified safety helmets.

title: Massive fraud involving Aswesuma
byline: Special Investigations Unit of the Hatton Police Division has initiated investigations of a fraud amounting to Rs.16.2 million of Aswesuma funds in Norwood Divisional Secretariat in Nuwara Eliya.

title: Scientists turn to sharks to improve hurricane predictions
byline: From the killer shark of ’’Jaws’’ to the tornado-tossed predators of the ’’Sharknado’’ movies, films long have portrayed sharks as objects of summer fear. But when a shark ​cuts through the waters off the U.S. East Coast, it now may be doing more than hunting. It may also be gathering data that helps ‌scientists understand the potential intensity of a hurricane before it makes landfall.

title: Mahanayake theras confirm letter sent to President on extending judges’  retirement age
byline: The Mahanayake theras of the three Chapters have written to President Anura Kumara Dissanayake expressing concerns on extending the retirement age of judges,  Mahanayake of Malwathu Chapter Most  Venerable Thibbatuwawe Sri Siddhartha Sri Sumagala Thera told a group of civil organisation leaders who met him today.

title: Award-winning actor Rosamund Pike to visit Sri Lanka
byline: Globe, Emmy, and Olivier Award-winning actor Rosamund Pike, Ambassador  to the Mines Advisory Group (MAG), is visiting Sri Lanka this week as the country marks the clearance of one million landmines over the past 17 years.

title: US appeals court blocks Trump’s $400 million White House ballroom project
byline: A U.S. federal appeals court ordered Donald Trump’s administration on Friday to stop construction on a $400 million ​ballroom on the site of the White House’s demolished East Wing, dealing the Republican leader a major setback in a case testing his presidential authority.

title: e-Passports within less than a year: Minister
byline: The government is planning to commence issuance of e-Passports within less than a year under the standards of the International Civil Aviation Organisation (ICAO), Public Security Minister Ananda Wijepala said yesterday.

title: Sri Lanka’s Free Media Movement condemns media restrictions in Pakistan
byline: The Sri Lanka-based Free Media Movement (FMM) has called on the Government of Pakistan to immediately halt state-driven violations of media freedom, expressing deep concern over new restrictive laws and administrative hurdles imposed on international media organizations and their journalists.

title: Jorge Messi, Lionel Messi’s father, dies at the age of 68
byline: Jorge Messi has died at the age of 68, according to multiple Argentine media outlets. Lionel Messi’s father had been battling health problems for some time.
